# Relationships

PDL is not a classical OO inheritance graph. Built-ins relate by **constructs**, **same RHS**, **shared child-flex props**, and **host conformance**.

| From | Relation | To | Notes |
|------|----------|----|-------|
| `Corner` | `constructs` | `CornerRadii` | Ctor name ≠ type name. |
| `IconRef` | `constructs` | `Icon` |  |
| `MediaLayer` | `constructs` | `Media` |  |
| `Background` | `sameRhsAs` | `Foreground` |  |
| `layout` | `sharesChildFlexWith` | `text`, `icon`, `media` |  |
| `EditableText` | `preludeHost` | `component` |  |
| `PointerInput` | `preludeHost` | `component` |  |
| `API protocol` | `mayRequire` | `host protocol` | `requires PointerInput` / `requires EditableText`. |

## Frame kind diagram

```text
                    ┌──────────── child-flex props ────────────┐
                    │ alignSelf, grow, shrink, position, inset │
                    └───────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
          ┌─────────┬─────────┬─────┴──────┬─────────┐
          ▼         ▼         ▼            ▼         ▼
       Layout     Text      Icon        Media    (any as
       (.layout)  (.text)   (.icon)     (.media)  layout child)
```

## Value ctor → type

```text
Corner(…)      → CornerRadii
IconRef(…)     → Icon
MediaLayer(…)  → Media
Shadow(…)      → Shadow
EdgeInsets(…)  → EdgeInsets
Blur(…)        → Blur
Vibrancy(…)    → Vibrancy
Ramp(…)        → Ramp
MediaSource(…) → MediaSource
```

## Host prelude

```text
component C <PointerInput>     // inbound pointer / focus / lifecycle
component C <EditableText>     // editing session + host verbs
protocol Api: component {
  requires PointerInput        // API protocols may require hosts
}
```
